description: Excessive urination due to elevated blood glucose levels, leading to excess fluid in the kidneys.

symptom: Tingling or numbness in hands or feet (Peripheral Neuropathy)
description: Nerve damage due to prolonged high blood sugar levels leading to loss of sensation.
suggested_remediation: Consult a neurologist, maintain proper foot care, and manage blood glucose levels closely.
possible_questions: Do you experience tingling, numbness, or burning sensations?
Is it constant or does it come and go?
